infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Todu shares your location with the people you choose when you trigger an SOS.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Todu needs background location so it can keep your circle updated during an emergency even when the app is closed.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Todu captures photo evidence only while an SOS is active, and only if you enable it.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Todu records audio evidence only while an SOS is active, and only if you enable it.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Todu can relay your alert through nearby Todu devices when there is no mobile network.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Todu needs background location so your circle can find you during an emergency.
